title: Explain atomic CLI update publication and recovery
when: Installing or updating the CLI, previewing an installer plan, or recovering a failed update
need: The installer dry-run shows private UV_TOOL_DIR and UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR locations and verification before atomic launcher publication. Running commands retain their release through leases. Candidate refusals preserve the current release; cleanup diagnostics name the cause and the update to retry. Manual update and the active connection relay use this same path.
